caption_L1: Most popular mobile messenger applications used in Poland in 2019 is a bar diagram. There is a categorical scale from BlackBerry Messanger to iMessage (Apple) along the y-axis, marked Response. Share of respondents is measured along the x-axis.
caption_L2L3: Messenger is the market leader, with twice the amount of users than its closest competitor, Whatsapp. The third and fourth most used applications, Skype and Twitter, had around half as many users as the leading two applications. The remaining seven applications trail, with few users.
